title: Thai-Style Roast Lamb
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai-inspired roast lamb dish, perfect for a special occasion. The combination of spices and herbs creates a delicious and tender meat.
instructions: Rinse the lamb and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the chili paste, curry powder, garlic, fish sauce (if using), brown sugar, and lemon juice.
Rub the spice mixture all over the lamb, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the lamb for 20-25 minutes per pound, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Let the lamb rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve with your favorite sides.
